guided_steps.desktop-folder-auto: In Claude Desktop, open each project you added, choose Auto in the mode selector under the message box, and do this once per project and account. EUTONOS then reads your newest session record to confirm it.
guided_steps.codex-trust: In Codex, open the project folder and choose Trust when asked. Or add a line [projects."<project folder>"] with trust_level = "trusted" to your Codex config.toml. Until you do, Codex ignores the project's own settings and rules.
guided_steps.codex-hook-trust: Held for now. When role hooks ship, Codex will ask you to trust each hook once.
guided_steps.desktop-rc-default: Optional. In Claude Desktop Settings, turn on Remote Control for new chats.
guided_steps.org-channels: Only a Team organisation admin can do this. Ask the admin to allow channels in the organisation settings.
guided_steps.claude-chat-copy: Optional, off until you switch it on. In the EUTONOS dashboard, open Settings > Claude, link your Claude accounts and switch on Chat copying. The Crosstalk helper then copies chat files between those accounts' Claude Desktop folders and never creates links.

guided_removal_steps.desktop-folder-auto: In Claude Desktop, change each EUTONOS project folder from Auto to your preferred mode if you no longer want Auto. Keep folders that use Auto for other work.
guided_removal_steps.codex-trust: In Codex, remove trust for EUTONOS project folders only if you no longer want to trust them. Preserve unrelated folder trust and your other config.toml settings.
guided_removal_steps.codex-hook-trust: Role hooks stayed held, so there is no new hook trust to undo. If you separately enabled hooks, remove only the EUTONOS hook trust you no longer want.
guided_removal_steps.desktop-rc-default: If you enabled Remote Control for new chats solely for EUTONOS, turn it back off in Claude Desktop Settings; otherwise keep your preference.
guided_removal_steps.org-channels: Ask your Team organisation admin to reverse an organisation channel permission granted solely for EUTONOS, if it is no longer needed. Preserve permissions used elsewhere.
guided_removal_steps.claude-chat-copy: In the EUTONOS dashboard, open Settings > Claude and switch Chat copying off. Chat files already copied into an account stay there; the helper's trash and snapshot folders under the device helper folder can be deleted by you.

tuning.why: Chats compact later and less often; the trigger is about the window minus 33000 (see tools/compaction_check.py).
Codex compacts at a limit sized to its model's context.
Codex chats think harder by default.

referenced_identifiers.why: Named by the Claude plugin on purpose and never allowed: creating a chat still asks.

outside_effects.where: the Windows Startup folder, one shortcut that starts the Crosstalk helper at login
outside_effects.why: The helper has to be running for letters to reach a chat after a restart.
outside_effects.removal: Uninstall or switching Crosstalk off deletes the shortcut while it is still EUTONOS's own.

outside_effects.where: a Startup shortcut (Windows) or a launch agent (macOS) that starts the Remote Control server at login
outside_effects.why: Lets you start new Claude chats from the web or your phone.
outside_effects.removal: Uninstall or switching the part off removes the shortcut or launch agent while it is still EUTONOS's own.

outside_effects.where: one Windows scheduled task, \EUTONOS Desktop Companion, that keeps the E icon running at logon
outside_effects.why: The companion is the E badge beside each app.
outside_effects.removal: Uninstall or switching the companion off deletes the task while it still runs what EUTONOS registered, and restores a task it replaced.

outside_effects.why: Remembers the Appearance (system, light or dark) you choose in the companion menu. Written only when you choose; never at install.
outside_effects.removal: Uninstall or switching the companion off deletes the value and its key when nothing else is in them.

outside_effects.where: the simon-planner skill folder under ~/.claude/skills, ~/.codex/skills and, when Hermes is found, its skills folder
outside_effects.why: Each app needs the skill file to know how to use Simon, the desktop-control helper.
outside_effects.removal: Uninstall or switching Simon off removes each file while it still holds the bytes EUTONOS wrote.

outside_effects.where: marked EUTONOS blocks in the instruction files of your projects and apps (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Hermes SOUL.md)
outside_effects.why: Agents read these blocks to follow the shared memory, Crosstalk and Simon rules.
outside_effects.removal: Uninstall removes only the marked block; the rest of the file is yours and is kept.

outside_effects.where: Claude's own plugin registry: the EUTONOS marketplace and the Crosstalk plugin, added through the claude command
outside_effects.why: Claude Code and Desktop load the Crosstalk plugin from there. The installer is the one writer of this registration.
outside_effects.removal: Uninstall runs the recorded claude plugin uninstall and marketplace remove commands.
